dashboard.title: Abuse & Edge Security Triage
dashboard.description: Operator dashboard for suspicious traffic concentration, Akamai edge action evidence, and false-positive candidate review using only MVP-safe abuse and security-correlation summaries.

options.content:
## Abuse & Edge Security Triage
Focus on concentrated suspicious traffic, Akamai action evidence, and potential over-blocking. `api_key_id` is intentionally sparse in the MVP, so the API key table omits `unknown` values rather than pretending the dimension is complete.

panels.title: Edge Action Share %
panels.description: Claim: edge controls are materially participating in the abuse story. Evidence: rows with any non-`none` Akamai edge action over all abuse-summary requests. Provenance: transform-derived action parsed from DS2 `securityRules`.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  round(
    100.0 * countMergeIf(`count()`, akamai_edge_action != 'none' AND akamai_edge_action != '')
    / greatest(countMerge(`count()`), 1),
    2
  ) AS value
FROM ${abuse_summary}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Abuse Edge Action Share; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Rate Limited %
panels.description: Claim: abuse pressure often first surfaces as throttling. Evidence: merged `rate_limited` share from the abuse summary. Provenance: transform-derived outcome with `unknown` fallback accepted.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  round(
    100.0 * countMergeIf(`count()`, rate_limit_outcome = 'rate_limited')
    / greatest(countMerge(`count()`), 1),
    2
  ) AS value
FROM ${abuse_summary}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Abuse Rate Limited Share; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Auth Rejected %
panels.description: Claim: auth failures remain a separate abuse signal. Evidence: merged `auth_rejected` share. Provenance: transform-derived auth outcome, sparse-safe by design.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  round(
    100.0 * countMergeIf(`count()`, auth_outcome = 'auth_rejected')
    / greatest(countMerge(`count()`), 1),
    2
  ) AS value
FROM ${abuse_summary}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Abuse Auth Rejected Share; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Unique Client IPs
panels.description: Claim: concentration should be read alongside spread. Evidence: merged unique client IP count. Provenance: abuse summary aggregate over normalized client IP.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  uniqMerge(`uniq(client_ip)`) AS value
FROM ${abuse_summary}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Abuse Unique Client IPs; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Blocked, Throttled, and Auth-Rejected Trends
panels.description: Claim: triage starts with trend separation across distinct abuse control paths. Evidence: merged counts for deny, rate-limit, and auth-reject categories. Provenance: abuse summary only.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
  countMergeIf(`count()`, akamai_edge_action = 'deny') AS denied,
  countMergeIf(`count()`, rate_limit_outcome = 'rate_limited') AS rate_limited,
  countMergeIf(`count()`, auth_outcome = 'auth_rejected') AS auth_rejected
FROM ${abuse_summary}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time
LIMIT 10000
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Abuse Control Trends; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Top ASNs by Suspicious Pressure
panels.description: Claim: high-impact network origins should rank first. Evidence: request volume, distinct IP spread, and edge-action share by ASN. Provenance: abuse summary dimensions only.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  client_asn,
  countMerge(`count()`) AS requests,
  uniqMerge(`uniq(client_ip)`) AS unique_ips,
  round(
    100.0 * countMergeIf(`count()`, akamai_edge_action != 'none' AND akamai_edge_action != '')
    / greatest(countMerge(`count()`), 1),
    2
  ) AS edge_action_pct
FROM ${abuse_summary}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND client_asn != 'unknown'
GROUP BY client_asn
ORDER BY requests DESC
LIMIT 15
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Abuse Top ASNs; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Top Countries
panels.description: Claim: geographic concentration matters for triage and tuning. Evidence: request volume and edge-action share by country. Provenance: abuse summary with normalized country attribution.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  client_country,
  countMerge(`count()`) AS requests,
  uniqMerge(`uniq(client_ip)`) AS unique_ips,
  round(
    100.0 * countMergeIf(`count()`, akamai_edge_action != 'none' AND akamai_edge_action != '')
    / greatest(countMerge(`count()`), 1),
    2
  ) AS edge_action_pct
FROM ${abuse_summary}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND client_country != 'unknown'
GROUP BY client_country
ORDER BY requests DESC
LIMIT 15
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Abuse Top Countries; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Top API Keys Where Present
panels.description: Claim: sparse identity still helps when it exists. Evidence: request volume and spread by `api_key_id`, excluding the fallback `unknown` bucket. Provenance: optional verified-native auth input normalized by the transform.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  api_key_id,
  countMerge(`count()`) AS requests,
  uniqMerge(`uniq(client_ip)`) AS unique_ips,
  round(
    100.0 * countMergeIf(`count()`, akamai_edge_action != 'none' AND akamai_edge_action != '')
    / greatest(countMerge(`count()`), 1),
    2
  ) AS edge_action_pct
FROM ${abuse_summary}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND api_key_id != 'unknown'
GROUP BY api_key_id
ORDER BY requests DESC
LIMIT 15
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Abuse Top API Keys; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Akamai Edge Actions by Policy and Rule
panels.description: Claim: policy evidence should be attributable to named rules. Evidence: merged request counts by policy, rule, and edge action. Provenance: transform-derived fields from DS2 `securityRules`; `none` rows are intentionally excluded here.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  policy_name,
  akamai_rule_id,
  akamai_edge_action,
  countMerge(`count()`) AS requests
FROM ${abuse_summary}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND akamai_edge_action != 'none' AND akamai_edge_action != ''
GROUP BY policy_name, akamai_rule_id, akamai_edge_action
ORDER BY requests DESC
LIMIT 20
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Abuse Edge Actions by Policy and Rule; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: False-Positive Candidate Evidence
panels.description: Claim: possible policy overreach shows up where strong edge intervention coexists with meaningful served traffic. Evidence: served-to-edge ratio by route and policy, plus p95 latency context. Provenance: hourly security-correlation summary only.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  route_group,
  policy_name,
  countMergeIf(`count()`, gateway_outcome = 'served') AS served_requests,
  countMergeIf(`count()`, akamai_edge_action != 'none' AND akamai_edge_action != '') AS edge_interventions,
  round(
    countMergeIf(`count()`, gateway_outcome = 'served')
    / greatest(countMergeIf(`count()`, akamai_edge_action != 'none' AND akamai_edge_action != ''), 1),
    2
  ) AS served_to_edge_ratio,
  round(ifNull(quantileTDigestMerge(0.95)(`quantileTDigest(0.95)(gateway_latency_ms)`), 0), 1) AS p95_latency_ms
FROM ${security_summary}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
GROUP BY route_group, policy_name
HAVING served_requests > 0
  AND edge_interventions > 0
ORDER BY served_to_edge_ratio DESC, edge_interventions DESC
LIMIT 20
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Abuse False Positive Candidate Evidence; du=${__user.login}'
